title: Inbox data: one record for the cards, and the inbox as the timeline of big things

chat.text: An Opus task mastermind maps every file the inbox reads today (board.jsonl, cards.jsonl, page.jsonl owner notes), decides the one appendable record it is built from, and turns the inbox into the scroll you asked for: every landed task's title and outcome newest first, mixed with your notes and needs-you items by the ranking that landed today, preview rail to detail to the card's own chat.
